params.reason: Verification `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_email_worker.py -v -k shutdown` fails with: ImportError while loading conftest → from models import Base → ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'models'. Root cause: database.py executes create_engine(postgresql+psycopg2://...) at module level, requiring psycopg2 which is not installed in the bundled Python (backend/Python/pythoncore-3.14-64/python.exe). All tests using conftest.py are broken by this. Fix needed: either install psycopg2-binary in the bundled Python, make database.py lazy-load the engine (don't call create_engine at module import time), or set DATABASE_URL=sqlite:/// for tests.
